  • Lead discovery, scoping, and decisioning: Translate fuzzy goals into crisp requirements, workflows, success metrics, and rollout plans; guide customers through tradeoffs, product constraints, and adoption choices.

  • Run the execution motion: Maintain multi-threaded project plans under ambiguity; coordinate across internal teams and external stakeholders; create clear operating cadences, risk tracking, and launch readiness.

  • Configuration and launch: Collaborate with product operations, engineering, and training teams to drive product configuration, data migration, launch, and successful adoption.

  • Inform and support product development: Partner with Product/Engineering to define net-new product workflows and requirements and help shape the product roadmap—based on scoping learnings, customer input, and real-world usage.

  • Build the scalable playbook: Turn lessons from engagements into repeatable processes, templates, and systems—improving speed and quality as we scale.

  • Attract top-tier talent to join our driven team

We’re scaling fast, solving real client problems with precision and ambition. Here, you own your impact; full autonomy, no micromanagement, no fluff.

Requirements

We’re looking for intensely driven, founder-minded leaders who want to test themselves and build something transformational. You likely have:

  • 3–6 years of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, product management, and/or founder/operator roles at high-growth startups

  • Strong technical intuition, demonstrated by STEM degree or equivalent technical background

  • Proven ability to take ownership and operate autonomously with strong judgement in fast-paced, ambiguous environments

  • Proven ability to independently manage complex projects end-to-end in a client facing setting

  • Excellent communication and ability to naturally build strong relationships and influence across internal and external stakeholders

  • Ability to operate creatively and flexibly while maintaining sharp attention to detail

  • Willingness to travel ~1x per month for ~3 days

  • Willingness to work in person at our office 4-5 days a week

Why Join

Growth and impact. It’s not often that you can get in on the ground floor of a funded (unicorn!) startup that’s scaling so fast. That means that instead of following a playbook, you’ll be writing it. Either way, the rest of the team will be here to support you.

  • Medical, Dental and Vision premiums covered at 100%

  • Fully paid parental leave

  • 401k benefits

  • Unlimited vacation and paid holidays

  • We'll cover relocation packages and make the move exciting, not painful!

As an Engagement Lead on the Future Platforms team, you’ll help found and scale a critical new function at EliseAI: taking our future platform products from early customer promise to live, adopted, business-impacting deployments. This is a cross-functional, high-autonomy role that sits at the intersection of product, strategy, and execution.

You’ll act as the primary driver of engagement success: building alignment across complex customer stakeholder groups, guiding high-stakes implementation and workflow decisions, and coordinating tightly with Product and Engineering to translate real-world needs into clear requirements and shipped improvements. Because this platform is early-stage and scaling quickly, you won’t just run engagements—you’ll systematize how we do them, building repeatable playbooks, processes, and systems that let us scale rapidly without losing quality.

This role is ideal for someone who wants to operate like a founder: comfortable with ambiguity, strong in stakeholder management and execution, energized by building internal systems that scale, and willing to do whatever it takes to drive customer outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

 - Own engagement success end-to-end: Serve as the primary driver of customer deployments from late-stage sales handoff through launch and post-launch stabilization; ensure outcomes, timelines, and stakeholder alignment.

 - Lead discovery, scoping, and decisioning: Translate fuzzy goals into crisp requirements, workflows, success metrics, and rollout plans; guide customers through tradeoffs, product constraints, and adoption choices.

 - Run the execution motion: Maintain multi-threaded project plans under ambiguity; coordinate across internal teams and external stakeholders; create clear operating cadences, risk tracking, and launch readiness.

 - Configuration and launch: Collaborate with product operations, engineering, and training teams to drive product configuration, data migration, launch, and successful adoption.

 - Inform and support product development: Partner with Product/Engineering to define net-new product workflows and requirements and help shape the product roadmap—based on scoping learnings, customer input, and real-world usage.

 - Ability to operate creatively and flexibly while maintaining sharp attention to detail

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About EliseAI

At EliseAI, we're improving the industries that matter most: housing and healthcare. Everyone needs a place to live and access to quality healthcare, yet both are often harder to secure than they should be.

By integrating AI agents deeply into existing workflows, we make them more efficient, reduce costs, and improve the experience for everyone.

  • Housing: We simplify how renters tour apartments, sign leases, submit maintenance requests, and stay connected with their property team—bringing everything they need for their home into one place.

  • Healthcare: We make it easy to schedule appointments, complete intake forms, and we help patients communicate with providers, so everyone can focus on health instead of paperwork.

With EliseAI, organizations reduce manual work, improve accessibility, and deliver a seamless experience across essential services. We recently raised a $250 million Series E round led by Andreessen Horowitz to accelerate this mission.

About the Role

As the Senior Product Marketing Manager, you'll be central to shaping how EliseAI positions and messages our AI for Housing products. As we fully determine our mature product positioning strategy your work will directly influence how customers understand the identity of EliseAI and our products. You'll develop and execute go-to-market strategies, craft compelling messaging, and drive product launches that accelerate adoption. Collaborating with teams across product, engineering, sales, and customer success, you'll ensure cohesive execution while bringing strategic clarity to our housing market positioning. This role owns real outcomes and shapes product marketing as EliseAI scales.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute comprehensive go-to-market plans that include product positioning, messaging, and launch strategies alongside Demand Generation and other key product and business functions to drive successful product introductions and growth

  • Conduct market research to understand customer needs, market trends, and competitive landscape, translating insights into actionable positioning

  • Help define the long-term positioning of EliseAI in the housing market, shaping how we differentiate across our full product suite

  • Closely track frequent feature releases and product upgrades, and own messaging and communications in a way that makes value clear and drives adoption at scale

  • Create clear and compelling product-level messaging that resonates with target audiences and reflects the latest market intelligence and competitive positioning across all products and features

  • Collaborate closely with product, engineering, sales, and customer success teams to align product strategies and ensure a cohesive approach to marketing products

  • Lead the development of marketing materials, including product collateral, sales tools, presentations, and case studies, to support product and feature launches and ongoing marketing efforts for all product updates and feature releases

  • Partner with Sales Enablement to equip the sales team with tools, training, and materials that enable them to effectively sell and promote products

  • Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders to gather feedback and inform framing - staying close to the grassroots is imperative

Move at rocket speed, build something massive.

We're scaling fast, solving real client problems with precision and ambition. Here, you own your impact—full autonomy, no micromanagement, no fluff. We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career. It's hard, it's intense, and it's the most rewarding work you'll ever do. If you're hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard.

Requirements

  • 6+ years of experience in B2B technology product marketing as a hands-on individual contributor and manager with a proven track record of driving market penetration, product adoption and growth

  • Demonstrated ability to shape product positioning and messaging, lead successful product launches, and drive ongoing marketing initiatives across the product lifecycle

  • Proven ability to distill complex technical concepts into clear, concise, and engaging narratives that resonate with target audiences

  • Excellent communication skills across written, verbal, and visual mediums, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams (Product, Engineering, Sales) and stakeholders

  • Track record of successfully managing multiple projects simultaneously and working independently to meet deadlines

  • Willingness to work in person at our office 4-5 days a week

Why Join

Growth and impact. It’s not often that you can get in on the ground floor of a funded (unicorn!) startup that’s scaling so fast. That means that instead of following a playbook, you’ll be writing it. Every single day you will be challenged to identify how we can scale and execute on it. You’ll learn what works when you succeed and what doesn’t when you fail. Either way, the rest of the team will be here to support you.

Benefits

In addition to the growth and impact you’ll have at EliseAI, we offer competitive salaries along with the following benefits:

  • Equity in the company

  • Medical, Dental and Vision premiums covered at 100%

  • Fully paid parental leave

  • Commuter benefits

  • 401k benefits

  • Fitness & home services stipend to cover part of your expenses so you can focus on what matters

  • A collaborative in-office environment with an open floor plan, fully stocked kitchen, and all meals covered in the office

  • Unlimited vacation and paid holidays

  • We'll cover relocation packages and make the move exciting, not painful!

Job Compensation Range

The salary range for this role is $170,000 - $210,000. EliseAI offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, equity, and a comprehensive benefits & perks package. Exact compensation is determined based on a number of factors including experience, skill level, location and qualifications which are assessed during the interview process. You will work closely with both technical and business teams internally and externally to guarantee the long-term success and value of each partnership. This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in scaling our partner ecosystem and driving business growth.

  • Take integrations from idea to launch: You will drive integrations end to end, aligning internal and external teams, managing dependencies, and pushing through blockers. You will be accountable for getting integrations live and ensuring they are stable, scalable, and built the right way from the start.

  • Be the technical lead for our partners: You will act as the primary technical point of contact for vendors, working directly with their engineering and product teams. You’ll align on integration strategy, guide implementation decisions, and step in when challenges arise to keep things moving forward.

  • Ensure integrations stay reliable over time: You will monitor API usage, track integration health, and put the right processes in place to support vendors long term. This includes managing API updates, reducing recurring issues, and improving visibility into integration performance.

  • Continuously improve the ecosystem: Beyond individual integrations, you will make it easier for vendors to work with EliseAI. You’ll improve documentation, add clear examples and troubleshooting guides, refine onboarding materials, and contribute to tools that simplify integration. You’ll also gather vendor feedback and help translate it into meaningful platform improvements.

  • Strong technical foundation, including understanding of system architecture fundamentals and APIs. Comfortable reading and reasoning about code (Python or similar)

  • Experience working directly with external technical stakeholders (e.g., vendor engineering teams, customer technical teams)

  • Ability to think strategically about integrations: assess tradeoffs, prioritize effectively, and make sound technical decisions

  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to manage timelines, track dependencies, escalate issues when needed, and drive work to completion

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across both technical and non-technical teams

Why Join

Growth and impact. It’s not often that you can get in on the ground floor of a funded (unicorn!) startup that’s scaling so fast. That means that instead of following a playbook, you’ll be writing it. Either way, the rest of the team will be here to support you.

  • Equity in the company

  • Medical, Dental and Vision premiums covered at 100%

  • Fully paid parental leave

  • Commuter benefits

  • 401k benefits

  • Fitness & home services stipend to cover part of your expenses so you can focus on what matters

  • A collaborative in-office environment with an open floor plan, fully stocked kitchen, and all meals covered in the office

  • Unlimited vacation and paid holidays

  • We'll cover relocation packages and make the move exciting, not painful!

Job Compensation Range

The salary range for this role is $140,000 - $200,000. EliseAI offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, equity, and a comprehensive benefits & perks package.   • Lead AI governance initiatives – Draft and enforce model-oversight, data-provenance, and ethics policies alongside Legal and Security teams

  • Provide accounting expertise – Guide engineering teams to ensure sound product and operating decisions

  • Continuous improvement – Monitor regulatory changes and industry best practices, refreshing frameworks proactively

Move at rocket speed, build something massive.

If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard.

Requirements

  • 5–7 years of total experience, with 3-4+ years in accounting, internal audit, or controllership (Big 4 or top-tier accounting advisory or multi-family property management preferred)

  • Solid grounding in core accounting (US GAAP) knowledge and processes

  • Clear, concise communicator able to influence cross-functional teams and present to senior leadership, auditors, and external clients

  • Willingness to work in person at our NYC headquarters 4–5 days per week

Preferred

  • Demonstrated ownership of SOX 404 or SOC 1 programs, ideally in a tech/software environment

  • Proven ability to convert control requirements into scalable system or process enhancements.

  • Familiarity with AI governance, model risk, or data-privacy regulations is a plus.

  • Professional certifications (CPA, CIA, CISA) preferred.

  • Real-estate or multifamily experience is advantageous but not required.

Why Join

Growth and impact. It’s not often that you can get in on the ground floor of a funded (unicorn!) startup that’s scaling so fast. That means that instead of following a playbook, you’ll be writing it. Either way, the rest of the team will be here to support you.

  • 401k benefits

  • A collaborative in-office environment with an open floor plan, fully stocked kitchen, and company-paid lunch

  • Fun company social events through our Elise and the City program

  • Unlimited vacation and paid holidays

  • We'll cover relocation packages and make the move exciting, not painful!

The salary range for this role is $170,000 - $220,000. EliseAI offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, equity, and a comprehensive benefits & perks package. The Growth Strategy Team

The Growth Strategy team is responsible for defining how EliseAI is positioned, understood, and valued in the market. We own the positioning and identity of the platform and every product within it, and we design and execute the highest-leverage growth initiatives that drive the company forward and generate pipeline.

Growth Strategy operates as a startup within a startup-run with the intensity and ownership of a founding team, but with the capital, market access, and product depth of a well-funded Series E. The mandate is zero to one: take products and platform capabilities from undefined to sharply positioned, then drive execution against that positioning across every surface that touches the market. Deep cross-functional involvement (Marketing, Product, Sales, Engineering, Leadership) and founder-level ownership from day one.

Roles on this team sit at the intersection that defines the best people at EliseAI: strategic thinking and deep context awareness, combined with technical ability and full ownership of execution. You will be expected to move fluidly between crafting a product narrative and building the automated systems that deliver it at scale-between shaping a go-to-market strategy and getting your hands into the data, tooling, and infrastructure to make it real.

About The Role

As a Manager on the Growth Strategy team, you’ll own the most complex and ambiguous problems the team faces-setting strategic direction on how products and the platform are positioned, defining the engagement architecture that drives customer lifetime value, and leading go-to-market execution across major initiatives. Where the Senior Associate owns projects, you own problem spaces.

You’ll operate with broad autonomy and minimal direction. In a given week, you might define the positioning strategy for an entire product line, architect the end-to-end engagement system for a customer segment, shape the GTM approach for a major launch, and build the analytical framework that measures all of it. You’ll flex between setting direction and getting deep into execution-between crafting the narrative and building the infrastructure that delivers it at scale.

This role is ideal for someone with a strategy, consulting, or operational background who operates at a high level of autonomy and wants to define what world-class looks like for a team at the center of how an AI company grows. You see positioning as a strategic weapon, you’re as comfortable in the data and tooling as you are in the narrative, and you thrive when handed a hard problem with no playbook.

Key Responsibilities

Positioning & Value

  • Own zero-to-one positioning across product lines and platform capabilities-defining the strategic frameworks, narratives, and value architecture that shape how the market understands EliseAI and why it wins

  • Build the systems for ongoing market and customer insight-creating feedback loops from win/loss data, customer conversations, and market dynamics that keep positioning sharp and inform product direction

Customer Engagement & Growth

  • Own the engagement architecture-designing and scaling the automated systems, nurture programs, and data-driven campaigns that drive measurable pipeline acceleration and customer lifetime value across segments

  • Set the analytical foundation for growth performance-establishing KPIs, building measurement frameworks, and driving a culture of optimization across all growth programs

Go-to-Market Execution

  • Lead go-to-market strategy for major launches and initiatives-serving as the connective tissue between Marketing, Product, Sales, and Customer Success to ensure new capabilities land with clarity, momentum, and commercial impact

  • Define and evolve the sales enablement strategy-ensuring our sales team has the positioning, materials, and training to communicate value effectively at every stage of the buyer journey

  • Serve as a strategic partner to leadership-directly influencing decisions on growth, market expansion, pricing, and customer value

  • Attract top-tier talent to join our driven team

Move at rocket speed, build something massive.

We’re scaling fast, solving real client problems with precision and ambition. Here, you own your impact-full autonomy, no micromanagement, no fluff. We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career. It’s hard, it’s intense, and it’s the most rewarding work you’ll ever do. If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard.

Requirements

We’re looking for intensely driven strategic operators who combine analytical rigor, technical fluency, and executional intensity. You likely:

  • Have 5–8 years of experience, with a foundation in management consulting, investment banking, strategy & operations, or a high-growth startup in a strategic or leadership capacity

  • Have a demonstrated track record of owning complex, cross-functional initiatives end-to-end and driving measurable business outcomes

  • Are exceptional at structuring ambiguous problems and setting strategic direction-you don’t wait for a playbook, you write it

  • Communicate with clarity and conviction-whether you’re crafting a positioning framework, presenting to the C-suite, or writing the copy yourself

  • Are equally comfortable in the strategy and the technical build-you can define the engagement architecture and get into the tooling to make it real

  • Have experience building systems and processes that scale-you don’t just do the work, you build the machine that does the work

  • Naturally lead across functions, building trust and driving alignment even without formal authority

  • Are willing to work in person at our office 4 days a week

Why Join

Growth and impact. It’s not often that you can get in on the ground floor of a funded (unicorn!) startup that’s scaling so fast. That means that instead of following a playbook, you’ll be writing it. Every single day you will be challenged to identify how we can scale and execute on it. You’ll learn what works when you succeed and what doesn’t when you fail. Either way, the rest of the team will be here to support you.

  • Equity in the company

  • Medical, Dental and Vision premiums covered at 100%

  • Fully paid parental leave

  • Commuter benefits

  • 401k benefits

  • Fitness & home services stipend to cover part of your expenses so you can focus on what matters

  • A collaborative in-office environment with an open floor plan, fully stocked kitchen, and all meals covered in the office

  • Unlimited vacation and paid holidays

  • We’ll cover relocation packages and make the move exciting, not painful!

Job Compensation Range

The salary range for this role is $150,000 - $250,000. EliseAI offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, equity, and a comprehensive benefits & perks package. Exact compensation is determined based on a number of factors including experience, skill level, location and qualifications which are assessed during the interview process. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided by our Recruiting Team during the hiring process.

  • Design, build, and optimize the engagement systems and automated programs that generate and accelerate pipeline—treating each as a product with its own architecture, measurement framework, and iteration cycle

  • Build and refine operating playbooks and scalable infrastructure that can be reused across products, segments, and go-to-market motions

  • Develop and ship high-impact sales enablement tools—equipping the sales team with the materials, training, and frameworks to communicate value effectively

  • Are biased toward action and comfortable making high-stakes decisions with imperfect information

  • Have a high degree of autonomy and strong judgment—you don’t wait for a playbook, you write it

  • Can drive others toward outcomes, even in ambiguous environments

  • Have a track record of demonstrated excellence in prior roles

  • Are equally comfortable defining strategy and getting into the technical build—you can architect an engagement system and get into the data, tooling, and automation to ship it

  • Naturally build strong relationships and influence across teams

  • Enjoy blending strategy, execution, and customer insight

  • Want to learn what it truly takes to build and scale a growth engine at an AI company

Growth and impact. It’s not often that you can get in on the ground floor of a funded (unicorn!) startup that’s scaling so fast. That means that instead of following a playbook, you’ll be writing it.   • Fully paid parental leave

You’ll play a key role in supporting employees and leadership while maintaining a high-quality office experience for the entire EliseAI team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee daily office operations, ensuring all common areas, conference rooms, and desks are clean, organized, and fully functional

  • Set up workstations and coordinate onboarding logistics for new hires

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for employees, guests, and vendors in the SF office

  • Greet and assist visitors, ensuring a warm and professional first impression

  • Manage incoming and outgoing mail, packages, and deliveries

  • Maintain building and office security access, including issuing, deactivating, and tracking employee and visitor badges

  • Coordinate daily group lunch orders and assist with catering or meeting setups

  • Support planning and execution of team events, celebrations, and meetings

  • Provide light IT and AV support, including troubleshooting basic issues, assisting with meeting room technology, and coordinating with remote IT when needed

  • Maintain inventory of office hardware and peripherals (monitors, adapters, cables, etc.) to ensure employees are properly equipped

  • Attract top-tier talent to join our driven team

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and stay adaptable in a fast-paced environment

  • Personable and welcoming; eager to create an enjoyable, well-run workplace

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills for working effectively with employees, vendors, and visitors

  • Proactive, hands-on problem solver with a can-do attitude and sense of ownership

  • Basic technical aptitude for furniture assembly, office equipment, and access systems, plus comfort with IT peripherals (e.g., monitors, adapters, cables, docking stations) and coordinating with remote IT for setup or troubleshooting

  • Dependable and punctual, with consistent attendance and follow-through

  • Comfortable performing manual tasks, including occasional lifting or moving of office items

  • Naturally proactive and solution-oriented, regularly asks, “What else can I support?” to improve the office and team experience

  • Willingness to work in person at our office 5 days a week

  • Fully paid parental leave

  • A collaborative in-office environment with an open floor plan, fully stocked kitchen, and all meals covered in the office

  • Unlimited vacation and paid holidays

  • We'll cover relocation packages and make the move exciting, not painful!

About The Role

We are looking for a Webflow-focused Web Developer joining the growth team who will live at the intersection of design, product, and engineering.

You won’t just be moving pixels: you’ll be a key driver of our digital presence, partnering with Product Marketing to launch campaigns, Design to push aesthetic boundaries, and Leadership to ensure our site reflects our strategic vision. Reporting to our Senior Web Developer, you will help maintain a high-performance, accessible, and scalable web ecosystem.

We operate in a hybrid environment with four days in the office.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build, launch, and maintain sophisticated web pages in Webflow, ensuring they are responsive, performant, and pixel-perfect across all devices.

  • Partner with the Design team to translate Figma prototypes into functional builds and work with Growth Product to implement growth strategies and conversion-focused landing pages.

  • Manage and optimize our Webflow CMS architecture, ensuring data is organized, scalable, and easy for non-technical teammates to update.

  • Conduct rigorous testing for browser compatibility, load speeds, and accessibility (WCAG compliance) before every push.

  • High-Velocity Design-to-Development Ops: A track record of partnering with Design teams to translate high-fidelity Figma prototypes into functional builds within a fast-paced environment.

  • Technical Quality Assurance: Experience conducting rigorous testing for browser compatibility, load speeds, and WCAG accessibility compliance before pushing updates to a live production site.

  • Willingness to work in person at our office 4-5 days a week

Why Join

Either way, the rest of the team will be here to support you.

  • Equity in the company

  • Medical, Dental and Vision premiums covered at 100%

  • Fully paid parental leave

  • Commuter benefits

  • 401k benefits

  • Fitness & home services stipend to cover part of your expenses so you can focus on what matters

  • A collaborative in-office environment with an open floor plan, fully stocked kitchen, and all meals covered in the office

  • Unlimited vacation and paid holidays

  • We'll cover relocation packages and make the move exciting, not painful!

Job Compensation Range

The salary range for this role is $100,000 - $130,000. EliseAI offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, equity, and a comprehensive benefits & perks package. Exact compensation is determined based on a number of factors including experience, skill level, location and qualifications which are assessed during the interview process.   • Run recurring enablement sessions to keep partner reps sharp on EliseAI positioning, ICP, and deal mechanics

  • Attract top-tier talent to join our driven team

  • Communicate QTD performance, blockers, and opportunities to the GTM Partnerships Lead

  • 2+ years in a fast-paced, startup GTM motion: sales, partnerships, alliances, or GTM strategy and operations

  • Demonstrated ability to drive revenue through a partner-led or co-selling motion

  • Executive presence with both startup and enterprise stakeholders

  • Strong Salesforce discipline: pipeline hygiene, attribution, and performance reporting

  • Direct, clear communicator, written and verbal; not afraid to speak up or push back

  • Fast executor: does not let perfect be the enemy of good

  • Self-starter with entrepreneurial instincts and high ownership mentality

  • Willingness to work hybrid (Chicago) or in-person 4-5 days/week (NYC)

  • Fully paid parental leave

  • 401k benefits

  • Fitness & home services stipend to cover part of your expenses so you can focus on what matters

  • A collaborative in-office environment with an open floor plan, fully stocked kitchen, and all meals covered in the office

  • Unlimited vacation and paid holidays

  • We'll cover relocation packages and make the move exciting, not painful!
